title: Get started with zupmxode
text: model written rxode2’s syntax read R’s parser, existing rxode2 models run unchanged. compiled native code milliseconds, without compiler.
code: m <- pmx_ode_model({   ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka); cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl); v <- exp(tv + eta.v)   d/dt(depot)   <- -ka * depot   d/dt(central) <-  ka * depot - cl / v * central   cp <- central / v }) m #> <pmx_ode_model> linear, 2 compartments on the native tier #>   compartments: depot, central #>   parameters:   tka, eta.ka, tcl, eta.cl, tv, eta.v #>   outputs:      ka, cl, v, cp pmx_ode_info(m)

text: Simulates population pharmacokinetic pharmacodynamic models written subset 'rxode2' model language 'NONMEM'-style event records, C compiler machine. Models parsed R compiled native code 'MIR', run interpreter native code made. Closed-form compartment models solved exactly, linear systems matrix exponential, rest 'LSODA' Dormand-Prince; subjects solved parallel 'OpenMP'.

title: zupmxode 0.0.0.9000
text: Initial CRAN submission. pmx_ode_tier() reports sets tier model runs : native code generated MIR, MIR’s interpreter. pmx_ode_model() compiles model written subset rxode2’s model language described documentation, including linCmt(). pmx_ode_events() builds NONMEM-style event table doses observation times. pmx_ode_solve() solves closed-form models (linCmt()) one subjects, exactly, time-varying covariates, resets steady state.
